The [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] |first_appearance = [[Hexscape Event]]}} ==Description== The '''Hex Realm''' is a realm that was first introduced in the [[Hexscape Event]]. According to the [[Conserver]], the realm served as a sanctuary for its inhabitants. Though, a sanctuary from who or what is unknown. The [[Conserver]] was able to somehow disconnect the '''Hex Realm''' from the entire realm network known to the [[T.D.S. Organization]]{{InlineQuote|Got word that the previous realm has no information on any other records. It was disconnected from the entire Realm network.|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 7 ([[Containment]])}} (most likely meaning the Meta), and it was only through the [[Children of Exo]]'s portal technology that the '''Hex Realm''' was forced open from its isolation.{{InlineQuote|I'm assuming the Conserver is what kept it off the grid until the Children of Exo forced it open. We're trying to find a way to reverse it.|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 7 ([[Containment]])}} The '''Hex Realm''' is mentioned to be "''unstable.''"{{InlineQuote|Look out ... this dimension is unstable ....|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 1 ([[The Nightmare Realm]])}} ==Inhabitants== The main inhabitants of the '''Hex Realm''' can be seen as dangerous from their demeanors{{InlineQuote|I can feel its hatred and anger ... from here ....|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 5 ([[The Nightmare Realm]])}} and violent encounter with the T.D.S. agents stuck in the realm, dangerous enough for the [[Dispatcher]] to fear that they may have the power to spread to other realms.{{InlineQuote|For now, we sent an emergency notification to all Realms to close off access. We cannot let them re-program and spread across the whole network.|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 15 ([[Containment]])}} Due to the '''Hex Realm''' being regarded as a sanctuary or refuge for the creatures that inhabit it, it can possibly be implied that they aren't native to the realm. The [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] was a being that was bound by the [[Conserver]] in the '''Hex Realm'''. It is unknown why the [[Conserver]] kept the [[Primordial Drakobloxxer]] imprisoned, but it is most likely to either keep it, or the [[God Cube]] fragment it held, from escaping to other realms.{{InlineQuote|You have released something the moment you defeated me that I have been conserving for so long... Now there's no way you're stopping it.|[[Corrupted Conserver (Narrator)|Corrupted Conserver]] on Wave 25 ([[Containment]])}} ==Trivia== * The existence of [[Hex Drako]] skulls on the shoulders of [[Fallen Necromancer]]s could possibly mean that the [[Fallen (Story)|Fallen]] have interacted with, or fought against the inhabitants of the '''Hex Realm''' in the past. ==Notes== {{StoryNavBox}}
